pipeline: L1: r2k watchlist (rebuilt Saturdays from Russell 2000 CSV) → L2: LuxAlgo 3 screeners on 1W (hard filter: BOS + Bullish/Strong Bullish S&O Rating + ▲/▲+ Signal) → L3: NW Envelope per-symbol check

nw_position_rules.inside: Room to run — valid entry candidate if R:R ≥ 1.5
nw_position_rules.extended: Price above NW upper band — small-caps can spike briefly, wait for weekly close back inside before entering
nw_position_rules.below_lower: Price below NW lower band — avoid

long: Symbol passed L2 hard filter (lux_screener_scan output: score ≥ 0)
NW position = inside (price between lower and upper band)
R:R ≥ 1.5: reward = NW upper minus price, risk = price minus NW lower
Adequate liquidity — avoid names where a normal position moves the price

exit_criteria.stop_loss: Below NW Envelope lower band on the weekly. Small-caps gap — size for a wider stop.
exit_criteria.take_profit_1: Scale out 1/3 when price touches upper NW Envelope band on weekly.
exit_criteria.take_profit_2: Trail remaining via weekly 9 EMA. Exit if closes below for 2 consecutive weeks.

risk_rules: Small-caps are high-beta — reduce position size vs large-cap trades
Do not enter if NW position = extended
Avoid illiquid names and sub-$5 prices
Sentiment ≥ 80% in small-caps = crowded pump risk — skip or half-size
asset_notes: Small-cap (Russell 2000) momentum names rebuilt weekly from CSV. Benchmarked to IWM. Pipeline: LuxAlgo 3 screeners (BOS + Bullish rating + ▲ signal) → NW Envelope extension check. In small-caps, high sentiment + high chatter (Overheated annotation) warrants extra sizing caution. Many names are low-priced and gap-prone — liquidity matters more than in large-cap book.
